ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ is in the derivative form: مَسَخَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
م/س/خ   m–s–kh to distort, to transmute, to transform into an ugly shape or ugly character, to disfigure; tasteless food, a plain person; to wear an animal thin by too much work. Of this root, only مَسَخْنَاهُم masakhnāhum, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مَسَخَ masakha a [v. trans.] to transmute, to transform, to change the nature of something for the worse, to disfigure

(36:67) وَلَوْ‏ ‏نَشَاءُ‏ ‏لَمَسَخْنَاهُمْ‏ ‏عَلَى‏ ‏مَكَانَتِهِمْ‏‏ and had We willed, We would have transmuted them in their places.
